bounded_conclusions: SIMPLE does not remove the in-place prepared-solve convergence problem.
Disabling MODERATE nonlinear under-relaxation allows the external nonlinear residual to reach the analytic root to approximately 1.3e-14 m/day, but MODFLOW still does not set its convergence flag.
Therefore delta-bar-delta history contributes to the physical-root stall but is not sufficient to explain the remaining subsystem convergence certification failure.
DSW-09R remains the positive control: fresh solve per reanchor closes both the external residual and MODFLOW convergence.
next: Hold under-relaxation disabled and sweep IMS residual closure during the same prepared-solve reanchor sequence.
